objective: Keep CARR reliable without using paid cloud execution as an iteration loop.

standing_rule_binding.instruction: Bind and approve the existing rule; do not create a replacement or ask Joe to approve its substance again.

global_policy.authority: Joe approval is required to raise a hard cap, buy usage credits, enable auto top-up, or add a new metered platform.
global_policy.cadence: Read usage weekly and before any cloud-heavy release or migration exercise.

platforms.scope: source control, pull requests, packages and GitHub Actions
platforms.billing_model: fixed GitHub plan plus metered Actions minutes and retained artifact/cache/package storage

live_evidence.actions_minutes_readback_blocker: the GitHub billing endpoints need the `user` OAuth scope this machine's token does not hold; Joe holds the reset verification instead (decision 9935743c-21de-4490-83db-d11a5e20f6b1)

hard_controls: $0 Actions budget with stop-usage enabled is the standing hard stop; the 2026-08-17 Actions pause was cleared 2026-09-12 and is no longer a control
one remote full CI run per publication candidate after local checks
platforms.optimization: Batch related changes into one branch and one PR; diagnose failures locally; cancel superseded runs; do not run post-merge CI when the identical protected source head already passed unless main-only integration evidence is required.

platforms.scope: production record layer, staging, disposable migration and restore branches
platforms.billing_model: Launch usage pricing with an organization spending limit
hard_controls: $10 organization spending limit
disposable branches must expire within two hours and be deleted by the creating run
branch cleanup failure fails the run
stop cloud test fanout when staging has more than two non-default branches
platforms.optimization: Use local static and hermetic tests for iteration; run one disposable database reconstruction for the final candidate; query the Consumption API without waking computes; keep staging restore history short; never leave test branches behind.

platforms.scope: production and staging CARR MCP Workers
platforms.billing_model: Free daily request quota or Paid monthly request and CPU-time allowance plus overage
hard_controls: set an explicit per-invocation CPU limit
rate-limit ingest and machine-token routes
alert before included request or CPU allowance is exhausted
platforms.optimization: Avoid polling loops, cache stable reads, bound list sizes, and keep health probes lightweight.
platforms.next_human_readback: Confirm Workers plan, current monthly requests and CPU milliseconds, and account-level spend notification settings.

platforms.billing_model: operation and storage metering under the Workers account
hard_controls: no list-scan polling
bounded token lifetime
one environment-specific namespace
platforms.optimization: Read by exact key, avoid repeated writes, and keep production and staging namespaces isolated.
platforms.next_human_readback: Confirm KV operation and storage usage in the Cloudflare dashboard.

platforms.billing_model: stored GB-month plus Class A and Class B operations; Internet egress is free
hard_controls: lifecycle retention for temporary artifacts
deduplicate by object checksum
do not use object listing as a polling loop
platforms.optimization: Batch backup copies, avoid redundant PUTs, and expire temporary test objects.
platforms.next_human_readback: Confirm R2 stored bytes and Class A/B operation totals.

platforms.scope: Claude and Claude Code interactive and scheduled work
platforms.billing_model: subscription usage windows shared by Claude and Claude Code, or API input/output/cache tokens when an API route is used
hard_controls: scheduled jobs remain disabled until ledger-backed
one task owns each workflow
API calls require a pre-dispatch cost reservation
platforms.optimization: Use typed bounded inputs, reuse cacheable context, consolidate scheduled jobs, and stop retrying long sessions after the first deterministic failure.
platforms.next_human_readback: Confirm Claude subscription tier, API billing organization, credits, and auto-reload settings.

platforms.scope: Codex desktop, local and cloud tasks
platforms.billing_model: included agentic usage by ChatGPT plan, then optional purchased credits; API use is token-metered separately
meter_units: API input and output tokens when API-enabled
hard_controls: no auto top-up without Joe approval
no duplicate agents on the same task
use local focused verification before cloud delegation
platforms.optimization: Keep one owning task, use bounded sub-tasks only when independent, and avoid re-running full repository analysis after every small fix.
platforms.next_human_readback: Confirm ChatGPT plan, Codex credit balance, and auto top-up state in the Usage dashboard.

platforms.scope: Google Drive vault, Gmail, Calendar and Google OAuth
platforms.billing_model: fixed Workspace seats and pooled storage; Drive API is quota-unit and egress limited
hard_controls: Drive API backoff and bounded pagination
no full-vault scans in routine work
no duplicate exported artifacts
platforms.optimization: Prefer canonical record-layer reads, incremental change tracking and stable IDs instead of repeated Drive searches or full exports.
platforms.next_human_readback: Confirm Workspace edition, licensed seats, pooled storage used, and Google Cloud Drive API quota usage.

platforms.scope: dead-man monitoring for exports, backup, Worker health and optional whole-chain status
platforms.billing_model: fixed plan primarily limited by number of checks and retained log entries; SMS and call credits on paid tiers
hard_controls: one check per distinct failure domain
no auto-provisioning
do not send verbose bodies on successful pings
platforms.optimization: Keep the four intentional checks and do not create per-run or per-branch checks.
platforms.next_human_readback: Confirm current Healthchecks plan and actual check count.

platforms.scope: human-gated social publishing and placement metrics
platforms.billing_model: commercial subscription or credits; exact contract not recorded
hard_controls: human-gated publishing only
draft generation cannot publish
metrics-only access must not inherit send authority
platforms.optimization: Batch approved weekly posts and do not spend credits on test publications.
platforms.next_human_readback: Record the Blotato plan, renewal, included credits and current balance from the billing page.
